mapper.select: select t.pk_id, t.rd_project_id, t.budget_code, t.budget_name, t.contract_code, t.contract_start_date, t.contract_end_date, t.contract_amount, t.payment_sche, r.RATIO project_allocation_ratio, t.create_by, t.create_date, t.update_by, t.update_date, t.contract_name, t.type, t.budget_amount, t.supplier, t.approved_date, t.is_research_project, t.tech_inno_point, t.contract_tax_points, t.supplier_name, t.expense_type, t.reimbursement_item, t.account_subject, t.is_invoice, t.payment_scheduling, t.invoice_Type, t.contract_Start_Date_Flag, t.contract_end_Date_Flag from rd_project_contract t inner join ppm.rd_project_contract_relation r on r.rd_project_contract_id=t.pk_id where r.rd_project_id =#{rdProjectId} and t.DELETED='0' order by t.create_date desc

select r.BUDGET_CODE, r.BUDGET_NAME, r.TYPE type, r.SUPPLIER, r.BUDGET_AMOUNT, r.APPROVED_DATE, t.PROJECT_CODE, t.PROJECT_NAME, p.RATIO, r.IS_RESEARCH_PROJECT , r.PAYMENT_SCHEDULING, r.CONTRACT_CODE, r.CONTRACT_NAME, r.CONTRACT_START_DATE, r.CONTRACT_END_DATE, r.CONTRACT_AMOUNT, r.CONTRACT_TAX_POINTS, r.INVOICE_TYPE, r.SUPPLIER_NAME, r.PAYMENT_SCHE, r.ACCEPTANCE_PHASE, r.EXPENSE_TYPE, r.REIMBURSEMENT_ITEM, r.ACCOUNT_SUBJECT, r.IS_INVOICE, r.MAINTENANCE_START_DATE, r.MAINTENANCE_END_DATE FROM ppm.rd_project_contract r LEFT JOIN rd_project_contract_relation p on (p.rd_project_contract_id = r.pk_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM rd_project WHERE DELETED = '0') t ON (t.pk_id = p.rd_project_id) LEFT JOIN ppm.COMM_RD_DEPARTMENT d ON (d.depid = t.competent_dept) ORDER BY r.BUDGET_CODE DESC, r.CONTRACT_END_DATE DESC
